race.description: James Costello WTC Thanks You For 29 Years Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: DRIALLE (1) failed to run a strong 1640m last start after a close second over 1500m at Kilcoy the run prior. Looks better placed over this shorter trip so should be competitive with the 3kg claim. Only needs some luck from the outside to be featuring in the finish. HEAVENLY LOVE (2) goes well for hoop Fazackerley who has a win and two placings from just four steers. Racing consistently this time in work and should be right there at the business end. KINGSLAND (3) has gotten better with each run this preparation and looks to be building up to another victory. Top-three credentials on best figures. HANG OUT (5) best of the rest from the favourable draw.
